text:
alex: vendor uploaded PT-931 to our shared bucket. path: s3://redwood-pt/reports/PT-931/2026-04-12/report.pdf
rachel: quick read — staging CMK policy grants arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ci-delegate Decrypt. Dedicated nodes aren't persisting SSM session transcripts. API Gateway redacts bodies. Need remediation plan + retest slot.
mikhail: immediate mitigation plan (staging-only): create replacement CMK (alias/redwood/staging-pt931-v2), rotate alias, remove the ci-delegate principal from old key policy, re-encrypt terraform state. I'll own KMS + tfstate.
rachel: i'll enable SSM session transcripts to s3://redwood-pt/ssm-transcripts/ and validate with a dummy session. runbook snippet: `aws ssm start-session --target i-0a1b2c3d --document-name AWS-StartInteractiveCommand` then check s3 prefix sessions/{instance}/{ts}.
sam: for API bodies propose a security-only archive s3://redwood-sec/pt-bodies/ encrypted with alias/redwood/sec-archive and 60-day retention. ingest lambda will scrub PII and emit object metadata (sha256).
sec-bot: Ticket created PT-931-REMED (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PT-931-REMED) :page_with_curl:
mikhail: proposed maintenance window tonight 01:00-02:30 UTC. owners: KMS+tf -> mikhail; SSM transcripts -> rachel; API archive -> sam. anyone object?
alex: ok for the window. please include rollback steps in the runbook.
mikhail: rollback plan: re-point alias to previous key id, restore tfstate from pre-change snapshot and abort rotations. i'll paste terraform/cli commands in the ticket.
rachel: evidence checklist for retest bundle: CMK creation CloudTrail events, key-policy diff (before/after), SSM transcript object keys (redacted), API archive object metadata + sha256, tfstate re-encrypt proof, and replay log showing exploit fails.
alex: retest ask to vendor: 1) attempt the same escalation path in staging (timeboxed 60m) 2) confirm SSM transcripts capture command transcripts and are only readable by eng-security 3) attempt replay against archived API bodies and show tampering vector gone. propose retest tomorrow 09:00-10:00 UTC.
sam: creating evidence bucket s3://redwood-pt/evidence/PT-931/ (access: eng-security only).
mikhail: i'll post full runbook + exact commands in the Jira ticket before the window. ping this thread with short status updates during ops.
alex: thanks team — keep pings concise. :white_check_mark:
